requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet for Torii & Hutukara, 16-bit top-down RPG. The two input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, showing the game's existing boss attack textures. Create a NEW HERO FX SPRITESHEET, not a boss explosion. Hero: FRANCO BASS, identity warm amber/ivory, woody dust and vibrating bass-string resonance. Exactly EIGHT COLUMNS and SIX ROWS of equally sized square cells, no lines, no labels, no text, actual TRANSPARENT background. Each row is one continuous animation with EIGHT DISTINCT authored drawings from left to right: 1 tiny anticipation,2 gathering material,3 advancing narrow stroke,4 compact asymmetric contact burst,5 broken release,6 separated flecks,7 very small residual,8 almost vanished residual. No sliding duplicate poses. All drawings centered consistently within their cells; very generous empty transparent space separates every drawing; no overlap between cells. Six rows: row1 one short plucked resonant streak to right; row2 two interleaving warm string streaks to right; row3 three brief chord filaments to right; row4 short low broken bass pressure ripple, open silhouette not closed ring; row5 compact woody resonant contact flecks and tiny amber harmonic fragments; row6 narrow warm traveling bass pulse to right, with 2 or 3 particles. Borrow the boss references' painterly pixel texture, earthy shadows, chipped edges and true changing material shapes, but make each effect smaller, airy, restrained. Matte clusters, tiny ivory core, open asymmetric shapes, no huge glow. At peak only 2-4 separated fragments, maximum occupied area about 15 percent of a cell. NO actual musical instrument, NO bass body, NO peg, NO full weapon, NO character, NO heart, NO amp, NO emblem, NO border or thick black outline, NO circle360, NO opaque disk, NO UI ornament, NO cyan, NO ground or scenery. Effects only, sharply pixelated game art. Canvas landscape aspect 8:6.
